description.value: Atlas Steak + Fish is a modern, upscale steakhouse and seafood restaurant operated by Gateway Casinos, situated inside Cascades Casino Langley on Fraser Hwy. The restaurant describes itself as a 'flirtatious and modern twist on the iconic North American steakhouse,' emphasizing premium ingredients, global flavour influences, and engaging table-side service. It is part of a multi-location Canadian chain with BC outposts in Langley, Burnaby, and Kamloops.
